newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac - 30-year loan demand grew in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac - 30-year loan demand grew in Q3.

text.p: Demand for 30-year fixed-rate mortgages made further gains on other types of loans among people refinancing their mortgages in the third quarter, a study relased by the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp Tuesday showed.
Among holders of existing 30-year loans, 63 percent refinanced to new 30-year loans in the third quarter, up from 53 percent in the second quarter.
The study said 22 percent of those with 30-year loans refinanced to 15-year loans in the third quarter, down from 33 percent in the second quarter.
